Here’s how to use Classroom Widgets on the desktop with a second screen, like a projector.
First, plug in your projector or second monitor.

In System Settings, open Displays, and set it to Extended display, not Mirror.

On Windows, choose Extend these displays.

Now your laptop is your working screen, and the projector is what the class sees.

Press Control, Option, Command and zero to open the Display widget.
